allowedEmpty.message: No channels allowed yet – in strict mode that blocks everything.

appTagline.message: Everything stays on this device. No accounts, no tracking, no network access.

blockPageInfo.message: Access is requested only for your blocked domains and revoked automatically when a domain is removed.

blockPageNoAccess.message: Without access, the browser keeps showing its error page for these sites.

confirmStrict.message: In strict mode every video is blocked until you allow channels. Switch anyway?

defaultUnlockPhrase.message: I really need this right now

dialogRetry.message: The code is wrong. Please enter it again.

dialogText.message: This change loosens your rules. Please let the person with the code enter it.

err_clock.message: The system clock was set back – unlocking is not possible.

err_cooldown.message: Too many failed attempts – please try again later.

err_cooldownUntil.message: Too many failed attempts – try again after $P1$.

err_disabled.message: This feature is turned off in the settings.

err_focus.message: No unlocks during a focus session.

err_locked.message: Not possible while locked – rules can only be tightened.

err_noRequest.message: The unlock request has expired – please start again.

err_notBlocked.message: This site isn't blocked right now.

err_phrase.message: The sentence doesn't match – only the letters count.

err_unreachable.message: Background service unreachable – please try again.

err_wait.message: Please wait until the waiting time is over.

extDescription.message: Resist the pull: blocks distracting sites, tames YouTube, unlocks only with deliberate friction – 100% local, no tracking.

extrasHint.message: All optional – turn on only what you need.

feat_blockPage_hint.message: Instead of the browser's error page: time left and unlock right on the page. Needs access to the blocked domains – only those, granted one by one.

feat_focus_hint.message: One click in the popup blocks everything on your list – unlocks and schedule pause.

feat_schedule_hint.message: Block websites only at set times, e.g. weekdays 9 to 5.

feat_stats_hint.message: Daily counters only (unlocks, focus, YouTube minutes, block page visits) – no addresses, no history. 30 days.

feat_ytLimit_hint.message: Limits your daily watch time on YouTube.

filterTip.message: Tip: separate multiple entries with commas. Keywords also match parts of words (“game” matches “gaming”).

focusAllBlocked.message: All sites on your list are blocked, unlocks paused.

focusTipAddSites.message: Tip: add websites to your block list first.

lockBanner.message: 🔒 Lock mode active until $P1$ – rules can only be tightened.

lockConfirm.message:
Activate lock mode until $P1$?

Until then you can only tighten rules, not loosen them.

lockHint.message: While locked you can only tighten rules: adding entries yes, removing or loosening no. The lock can be extended but never shortened.

lockedNoToggle.message: Can't be turned off while locked

modeBlacklistHint.message: Blocked channels and keywords are hidden.

modeWhitelistHint.message: Everything else is blocked – ideal for learning and work channels.

noUnlocksLeft.message: No unlocks left today ($P1$ of $P2$ used).

notBlockedSchedule.message: Not blocked right now (outside your schedule).

notBlockedText.message: This address is not (or no longer) on your block list.

partialApplied.message: Because of an active lock or partner code, only tightening changes were applied.

partnerHint.message: The strictest option: someone else sets a code. From then on, rules can only be loosened with that code – tightening always works. The code is stored only as a PBKDF2 hash, never in plain text.

partnerNewPrompt.message: Enter the new code (at least 6 characters). The current code will be asked for next.

pillPartnerTitle.message: Loosening only with the partner code

privacyText.message: Sirenward stores only your settings and what timed unlocks need (today’s counters) – locally in the browser (storage.local, not synced). No history, no servers; statistics only if you turn them on. The extension has no technical way to send data.

reasonList.message: You put this site on your block list.

reasonLock.message: Lock mode active until $P1$. You committed to this yourself.

scheduleNoDay.message: Please choose at least one day.

scheduleOvernight.message: If the end is before the start (e.g. 10 pm to 6 am), the schedule runs overnight.

scheduleSame.message: Start and end can't be the same.

sitesHint.message: Applies to the domain and all subdomains. The block lives inside the browser, so it also works with a VPN.

unlockHint.message: Briefly unlock a blocked site – with deliberate friction: first a waiting time, then type a sentence (only the letters count). Afterwards the site locks itself again. Unlock from the popup or the block page.

ytFilterHint.message: Blocked videos disappear from feeds and search. Opening one directly shows a block screen.

ytHomeHidden.message: Home feed hidden – use search or your subscriptions.

ytPaneHint.message: Calm YouTube down: hide distractions and filter what you see.

yt_disableAutoplay_hint.message: The next video won't start on its own.

yt_grayThumbnails_hint.message: Less visual pull – read titles instead of clicking pictures.

yt_hideEndscreen.message: Hide end cards & suggestions in the player

yt_hideExplore_hint.message: Trending, Explore and topic channels disappear from the menu.

yt_hideHome_hint.message: No suggestions the moment you open YouTube.

yt_hideSearchSuggestions_hint.message: No suggestion rabbit hole while typing a search.

yt_hideShorts_hint.message: Shorts links open as a regular video with a seek bar.

yt_reason_keyword.message: The title contains a blocked keyword.

yt_reason_limit.message: Your YouTube daily limit is used up for today. More tomorrow.

yt_reason_notAllowed.message: This channel isn't on your allowed list.

yt_reason_unknown.message: The channel couldn't be identified – strict mode blocks it.

yt_redirectHomeToSubs_hint.message: Your subscriptions instead of the home page.
